name: estate-manager
description: Rental management system: income, weekly reports, lease renewals, utilities

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install --include=dev && npm --prefix client install --include=dev
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c green,cyan "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix server install --include=dev && npm --prefix client install --include=dev && npm --prefix client run build
